historical_measurement_scope: Exact historical qualified artifacts are retained unchanged. Current bounded tests do not repeat or extend their quality/operating samples.

review.source: Release recipe/extractor/claim registries unchanged from qualified source; later ordinary runtime source changes are neutral demo configuration and custody bytes. Current bounded assembly/authorization/version/signing tests passed.
review.evidence: Final card only supersedes historical draft readiness/key availability wording; source facts, limits, gaps, tiers, uncertainty and expiry triggers are unchanged.
review.security: Existing authenticated visibility/source/generation/citation fences, signed binary/artifact bindings and no experimental fallback retained.
review.steady_state_cost: No implementation change. Selected products use existing bounded workers/shared extraction passes and readers. Selection adds one bounded artifact census plus running-image hash at startup; no per-request artifact hashing, new cache, lock, child class or changed ceiling. First stable admission replaces incompatible generations using existing reconciliation.

not_established: New extraction accuracy or truth population
Linux capacity, scale or latency/throughput SLO
Live source deployment or corpus migration
Managed SCIP installation or T42 ceremony readiness
